limitations: Finite composition sums only, Banach exponents 1 through infinity; the general exact norm is a limit/supremum, the endpoint stabilization cutoff is map-dependent, and independent priority/correctness assessment is outstanding.
scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof is supplied. Numerical assertions are auxiliary. The motivating two-map example and prior compactness theorem are credited rather than claimed as new.
title: Exact essential norms and finite-rank rigidity for composition sums on discrete Hardy trees
